title: Human thermal heterogeneity reshapes building energy, carbon and flexibility
physical_parameters: frozen; no recalibration or building replacement
new_physical_runs: only if a specified comparison cannot be answered from retained trajectories; no open-ended search

service.reference: retain all declared candidates including common 25 C fallback
service.matching_tolerance_meaning: numerical comparison resolution, not an empirical acceptability threshold

spatial.primary: fixed profiles, random-placement absolute service limits and tail identities, equal-profile weighting
spatial.nested_candidate_ordering: mathematical property, not an independent empirical discovery

response.primary: own annual-selected baseline; event and 48-hour recovery service checks
response.accounting: two-hour event plus 48-hour recovery, electricity and heating gas separately
response.date_classes: original February/July peak dates; existing July median and P90 checks kept separate

personal_ranges.method: retain the Li et al. Building and Environment 2026 elicitation framework and existing numerical adaptation
personal_ranges.interpretation: model-generated scenario inputs; not new measured individual acceptance ranges

stopping_rule: complete the four specified checks, retain all outcomes and missing matches, cross-review, update documents/figures/replay once; do not add unrelated experiments
